bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The biggest Bears story right now centers on quarterback Caleb Williams' hamstring injury, as he feels ready to play against the Atlanta Falcons, although coach Ben Johnson hasn't made a final decision on whether to start him . Williams was a full participant in practice again Thursday, but it has not yet been determined whether he will start Sunday's game in Atlanta , as the Bears look to bounce back from last week's blowout loss to the Packers.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: During their bye week, the Detroit Lions made roster moves to bolster depth, signing veteran returner and wide receiver DeAndre Carter to the practice squad after losing their primary punt and kick returner, Tom Kennedy, for the season due to a knee injury that will require surgery. The team also continued to get positive news on offense, with running back Jahmyr Gibbs being named NFC Offensive Player of the Week for the fourth time this season.

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Packers received good injury news ahead of their Sunday Night Football matchup with the Dallas Cowboys, as head coach Matt LaFleur confirmed Friday that star cornerback Keisean Nixon will play despite dealing with a groin injury during the week . Green Bay enters the primetime contest riding momentum from a dominant 31-7 win over the Bears and looks to continue its strong recent form, having posted a 10-1-1 mark in the last 12 meetings between the teams against Dallas.

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The biggest storyline continues to be the Vikings' 5-0 start, with reports indicating the team has quite a bit to fix on offense when they come out of their bye week, despite positive signs in their 23-13 win over the New Orleans Saints in Week 5 . Meanwhile, trade speculation is heating up as wide receiver Jauan Jennings posted a cryptic social media message amid growing speculation that he could be traded .
